check_box.label: Enable My Lights
check_box.name: as_light_master_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Master switch: turns every light in the list on or off at once, without changing their settings.

combo_box.name: as_light_render_backend
combo_box.tool_tip: A/B test the current viewer-object lights against direct deferred-shader lights.

check_box.label: On
check_box.name: as_light_on
check_box.tool_tip: Turns this light on or off, keeping its settings. Enable My Lights still switches every light at once.

combo_box.name: as_light_placement
combo_box.tool_tip: Follow avatar: the light moves with one of your joints. Fixed: the light stays where it is placed, in that region.

text.name: as_light_region
text.tool_tip: Region this fixed light is placed in. Away means that region is not loaded, so the light is off until you return.

button.name: as_light_place_camera
button.label: Place at camera
button.tool_tip: Fixes the light at the camera's position, in the region there.

button.name: as_light_place_focus
button.label: Place at camera focus
button.tool_tip: Fixes the light at the camera focus point. After an Alt-click on an object this is near the object's middle rather than on its surface; without one it is at your avatar.

slider.label: Height (m)
slider.name: as_light_height
slider.tool_tip: Offset along the anchor joint's up axis.

slider.label: Azimuth (deg)
slider.name: as_light_azimuth
slider.tool_tip: Angle around the anchor joint; 0 is in front.

slider.label: Offset X (m)
slider.name: as_light_pos_x
slider.tool_tip: East (+) / west (-) offset from where the light was placed. Placing again resets it to 0.

slider.label: Offset Y (m)
slider.name: as_light_pos_y
slider.tool_tip: North (+) / south (-) offset from where the light was placed. Placing again resets it to 0.

slider.label: Offset Z (m)
slider.name: as_light_pos_z
slider.tool_tip: Up (+) / down (-) offset from where the light was placed. Placing again resets it to 0.

slider.label: Intensity
slider.name: as_light_intensity
slider.tool_tip: Light intensity, capped at 1.0 by the underlying light protocol. For a brighter effect, increase Radius or decrease Softness instead.

slider.label: Softness
slider.name: as_light_falloff
slider.tool_tip: Softness of the light's edge falloff.

combo_box.name: as_light_background
combo_box.tool_tip: Overrides the scene background for isolate-avatar photography.

color_swatch.name: as_light_background_color
color_swatch.tool_tip: Custom background color, used when Background is set to Custom.

check_box.label: Show other avatars
check_box.name: as_light_show_other_avatars
check_box.tool_tip: Keeps other avatars and their attachments visible against the isolated background.

check_box.label: Show light beacons
check_box.name: as_light_show_beacon
check_box.tool_tip: Shows a cross marker at each light's position. Never appears in snapshots.

check_box.label: Freeze animations
check_box.name: as_light_freeze_anim
check_box.tool_tip: Freezes all avatar animations in view (same as AyaneStorm > Animation > Freeze Animations).

check_box.label: Spotlight
check_box.name: as_light_spot
check_box.tool_tip: Turns this light into a spotlight aimed at a joint of your avatar. LLVOVolume backend only; the Shader backend keeps it a point light.

combo_box.name: as_light_aim_joint
combo_box.tool_tip: Joint the spotlight points at. It follows the joint as you move and animate.

slider.label: Aim yaw (deg)
slider.name: as_light_aim_yaw
slider.tool_tip: Turns the aim away from the joint; positive turns left, as seen from the light.

slider.label: Aim pitch (deg)
slider.name: as_light_aim_pitch
slider.tool_tip: Tilts the aim away from the joint; positive tilts up.

slider.label: Focus
slider.name: as_light_spot_focus
slider.tool_tip: Sharpness of the projected image; same as the build floater's light Focus.

slider.label: Ambiance
slider.name: as_light_spot_ambiance
slider.tool_tip: Light spilled outside the cone; same as the build floater's light Ambiance.

texture_picker.name: as_light_spot_texture
texture_picker.tool_tip: Image projected by the spotlight. None gives a plain white cone.

combo_box.name: as_light_list_filter
combo_box.tool_tip: Active here: worn lights and fixed lights placed in this region. All lights: every light, including fixed lights in other regions. Switches to Active here after a teleport.

button.name: as_light_clear_region
button.label: Clear region
button.tool_tip: Deletes every fixed light placed in the region you are in, after confirmation.

button.name: as_light_clear_away
button.label: Clear away
button.tool_tip: Deletes every fixed light in regions that are not loaded, after confirmation.

check_box.label: This region only
check_box.name: as_light_preset_region_only
check_box.tool_tip: Save only the fixed lights placed in this region. Loading such a preset replaces only that region's fixed lights and leaves all other lights alone.

check_box.label: No eye highlights
check_box.name: as_light_no_eye_specular
check_box.tool_tip: Removes My Lights specular highlights (catchlights) from your avatar's eyes. Eyes still receive the light's diffuse illumination. Shader backend only.
